en: Is a parent's duty not to his child?
Then he may demonstrate it, and I will place my limits accordingly.
LUNA: Well met, \PN!
Tell me, have you seen any place especially lovely on your travels?
I would so love to hear!
I've seen so many wonderful places, of course, but I am quite sure I can't have seen them all!
It is a marvelous world out there.
And out here, as well.
LUNA: How do you do?
LUNA: This dance floor is rather dreamlike in its own way, is it not?
It is not to my comfort to partake, but I hardly mind the atmosphere.
LUNA: Unlike some of the others, I have no magic or powers to back me up--
None more than any normal person may carry, anyway.
But then, with courage and an adventurous spirit, that may yet be a lot more magic than many might assume.
LUNA: It is ever kind of you to continue policing this place as such.
May your strength be as unfaltering as your resilience.
SAMSON: Hi.
Glad you made it back.
I wanted to say sorry for back there.
I don't remember everything that happened back there... but I've been getting bits and pieces.
Remembered enough to know I need to apologize.
If you and the Boss hadn't found me there...
Well. Thanks.
Glad you finally made it back.
People've been pretty worried.
Soon as I got here, that Julia girl came over, and--
Well, I guess you know how she is.
To tell the truth, she and Terra'd probably get along,
If Terra weren't...
But she said you got taken by a Necrozma after you beat Lin.
Said it swooped in and got you before you could even react.
Didn't really know how she could have known that, seeing as she wasn't there,
But when I asked, she just said she had her sources.
Well, whatever happened, I'm glad it didn't eat you.
SAMSON: I saw Ciel's back.
Had a chat with her.
Heard what you did.
Thanks, champ.
You did what I couldn't.
And, man... I'll regret saying this,
So don't you tell her I said it,
But honestly, I'm just happy she's okay.
SAMSON: Thanks for bringing the gang back together.
It uh...
Let's just say our bartending friend was starting to get a little concerned about me and my intake volume before.
Trying to run from the loneliness.
Listen, you can't tell them I said this, right?
I'll never hear the end of it.
You did good, Champ.
SAMSON: Nice work winning the tournament.
The boss still isn't quite over it.
Now and then she mutters about 'the best act that got away'.
Well.
Circus isn't a bad place to work. That Pokémon would've been treated well enough,
But honestly...
Between you and me, I'm glad you won.
Just keep her out of trouble, would you?
And maybe... away from the boss.
SAMSON: Nothing at space junk site #3002, was I right?
Telling you, these New World pockets are a dime a dozen.
We may as well not even explore them.
If there's nothing running out of it screaming, what's the big idea, right?
Basic triage.
For instance, there was this time a bit ago, I think around the time you were helping out those Meteor girls...
We were out at the bridge, and suddenly,
Boom--
Like three of those ugly Buzzwole things just blast out of nowhere and start swarming people.
Now, we were all there, all three of us--
Thanks to you, mind--
One goes off flying and Ciel can chase it down.
One goes straight for a civ'.
I slug it in its ugly mug, three minutes later I've got it in a chokehold.
I'll spare you the details of what Terra did with hers.
Point is, we got a bulletin about a new space only a few moments before.
If we'd dashed off to deal with it, who'd've saved the civ, you know?
Smart priorities, Champ.
Stay vigilant.
SAMSON: How much you wanna bet I can beat the champion savior of the region in an arm wrestle match?
Technically, that makes me the strongest, right?
SAMSON: You finally made it to the top.
Lonely, isn't it?
Now you see why the rest of us are down here.
SAMSON: Join me for a shot sometime.
I won't tell if you're not of age.
Champ deserves a drink or two.
SAMSON: Keep at it, champ.
You never know who might just lap you if you don't.
SAMSON: I'm just chilling here, if you're bored.
The boss sure as hell doesn't pay me enough not to kick back when I can.
CHARLOTTE: Whoa, \PN?
...Huh.
So tell me.
Did Lin really turn you into a baby, or was Julia pranking me?
It sounded kinda convincing, but...
You don't look like a baby.
CHARLOTTE: Nothing, huh?
Well, whatever. Glad you're not a baby now, at least.
Babies can be kind of annoying, but you're fun to hang out with.
Babies can be kind of annoying.
CHARLOTTE: I suppose you didn't conveniently forget everything that happened at the Mirage Tower did you?
Please?
Because if not, I'm gonna have to come up with some edgy, dramatic spiel to save my image.
In fact, let's just both pretend I did that already, cool?
Cool.
I'm only upset ironically or something.
So yeah, uh, don't forget it or whatever.
CHARLOTTE: I heard a Meloetta was causing trouble at the circus earlier.
I assume you caught it?
I mean, good for you, but honestly?
I don't get what the big deal is.
From what Serra said, there was a whole crowd there wanting to meet it?
But... there's legendary Pokémon all over the place.
What made everyone go gaga for Meloetta in particular?
Was it the Anomaly aura or something?
I dunno. I don't get it.
But hey, maybe you can introduce me sometime and I'll see what all the fuss is about.
CHARLOTTE: Huh?
Oh, hey.
Just finishing up this book.
I know this is a weird place to read, but Shelly loaned it to me, and I want to give it back before she leaves.
Did you know she has all kinds of wicked books in that library in her Gym?
This one's about a warlock whose family died in a fire, so he goes on a suicidal revenge mission...
...But he doesn't know that he was actually the one who caused the fire.
It's pretty cool, but I've got some... mixed feelings about it.
I'm just finishing this up, though.
I'll tell you about it after, though, in case you want to check it out.
CHARLOTTE: Sup?
CHARLOTTE: Hey, ready to eat dirt in a rematch?
CHARLOTTE: Thanks for hanging around despite everything.
CHARLOTTE: I'm thinking about changing my style.
Think a leather jacket would suit me?
Or the ethical alternative, whatever.
Caring about shit is punk, obviously.

CIEL: \PN, is that you?
Oh, it's good to see you, but-
Are you sure it's all right for you to be out and about like this?
CIEL: Oh, you don't need to worry about telling me, darling.
Julia already filled me in on the situation.
Witness protection!
Such drastic measures, but I wasn't surprised at all.  Team Meteor was a beast of a group.
But-- you're here now!
Perhaps this means it's been long enough that they've released you?
It has been a fair while...
Well, it's good to see you, darling.
I'm sure you're eager to reunite with everyone, so I won't keep you.
CIEL: Hello, darling.
I must thank you again for helping me out of that...  predicament.
I must say, I far prefer this place to that one, don't you?
Why, it even reminds me a little of the circus, with all its bright lights and merry music.
Oh, I know I'll head back eventually.
Despite... what I may have said, I truly do love the spotlight.
The thrill of landing an extravagant aerial finish--
I can't think of anything more grand.
Still...
CIEL: Perhaps I'll stick around here a while, first.
Do some... reflection.
And, of course, enjoy this lovely scene!
I'm sure the Ringmaster can spare me just a little longer.
CIEL: Ah, he's back is he...
...Well, it's not that I'm not grateful!
I just... don't know how to face someone like that, you know?
"Thank you for saving my life at the cost of your own; care for a tea?"
I'll have to think about it,
But it is surely a weight lifted nonetheless, and you have my gratitude.
CIEL: Ah, so...
I told you about my cousin, did I not?
I didn't know you were already acquainted!
How serendipitous, and only slightly embarrassing!
Still, you were able to rescue them too.
I had no idea what had even happened!
You best believe I have given Terra the whalloping of a lifetime.
She has begged for mercy, as she ought,
And I have allowed her it, as I ought.
After all, I understand it was my carelessness that pushed them to the extreme from which they fell.
You have my thanks again, \PN,
That we both may have a chance at forgiveness.
CIEL: Another successful spelunking, I presume?
Hunting for Legendaries this way and that is certainly one way to pass the time...
Not sure it's my favorite on my own.
Ah, but the company makes the moment, does it not?
Even Terra is not so bad for such things.
We've gone soaring through space no small number of times thanks to her...
But here we are!
I'll look back and laugh someday,
After therapy.
Still, I don't think I'd pass it up even if I had the option.
You have my thanks for pulling her back in.
CIEL: Goodness, I feel like we should have seen each other once more if you were at the circus,
But it seems like we just missed each other.
I was busy with challengers during the Battle Wheel tournament, you see.
I do wish I had been able to come out and catch at least a glimpse of the performance.
I'm told it was quite beautiful.
Do you think she learned it from somewhere?  Meloetta, I mean.
Or did she come up with it on her own?
Oh, but you caught Meloetta, did you not?
I wonder...
No, no, I won't ask you to bother her now.
I'm sure she needs plenty of rest, after a day of performing.
But perhaps someday, we could talk.
Until then, do take care of yourself, \PN!
CIEL: Even this kind of dancing has its tricks, tips, and postures!
Pay close attention to the arch of my back; you'll see!
CIEL: How easy it is to forget ourselves here!
How lovely that must be...
CIEL: \PN, I would love to see your own form of dance!
CIEL: This place is so bright, it really does remind me a bit of the circus!
A bit less Donphan dung, though, of course.
ADRIENN: There's my favorite Champion!
I didn't get much of a chance before, with everything, but--
I wanted to find a minute to say thank you.
You're truly a Champion, through and through.
But of course, I always knew you could do it!
I'm not sure how much I'll be able to stick around here, what with everything at the Grand Hall--
The amount of paperwork has been astronomical...
But I'll stop by whenever I can to help.
And you're always more than welcome to drop by the Grand Hall!
I'm sure the Vulpix will love to see you, too!
ADRIENN: Let's visit that place again sometime.
With the stars and all the pools...
It was quite incredible.
That feeling of timelessness...
I have it only in my memories.
I miss it so much.
And if there were anyone to indulge it with...
ADRIENN: You're the hero of the day, once again.
I truly can't thank you enough, \PN.
The train robbery was a... volatile situation, and you handled it wonderfully.
I suppose it's probably too much to hope for, that that Corin-Rouge fellow has learned his lesson...
But I believe I'll hope for it nonetheless.
He seemed to have good intentions, after all... just let things go a bit too far.
And thankfully, no one was badly hurt.
We really should work on trying to figure out a solution to the water problem out in Train Town.
Just another thing to look into, I suppose.
Oh, but don't you worry about that, \PN.
I'll let you know if there's anything you can do,
But in the meantime, please take care of yourself.
And let's hope that little troublemaking Pokémon is through with that, too.
We don't want things going missing around here!
Enough things get lost as it is...
ADRIENN: You know, I can't help thinking.
While the circumstances might not be ideal-- look at this place.
All these people working together, making things better.
It's inspiring, isn't it?
Reborn's future really does look bright.
ADRIENN: Whatever you need, Champion.
If it's within my power, just say the word.
ADRIENN: I can't say this is my kind of environment.
The people, sure-- but the place...
It's... novel?
Let's go with that.
ADRIENN: Let's have a rematch sometime, Champion.
We are all bettered by each other.
ADRIENN: How can I help you, friend?
Or were you just checking in?
TITANIA: I was surprised to see you here.
I had heard you finally got fed up with all our chaos here and took the first train out of the region you could get.
Wouldn't have blamed you if you never looked back.
In fact, I considered following suit.
But here you are.
Why?
It sounded like a perfectly reasonable course of action to me.
Maybe some day I'll get the chance to take it myself.
TITANIA: Thanks for snapping me out of it.
Feel free to snap harder next time.
I don't want an embarrassing mistake like that on me for longer than necessary.
Zero recollection until I came to.
I don't like anyone having that kind of influence over me.
...But what's done is done, and in the end,
Maybe it was for the best.
Now I have the distance I needed.
Freedom to think.
Nothing to run from.
...I've been thinking about writing more.
Easier than battling.
Whenever I lose, I think,
"Maybe I should stick to books."
But even when I mess up at writing, I'm not thinking "Maybe I should've stuck to battling."
There's something there.
Something important.
TITANIA: I know a lot of people won't believe me, but I don't exactly relish turning my blade on people.
I don't love violence.
It's just the only thing that some people listen to.
It's the only thing some people can listen to anymore.
In the case of Aya's step-father, I'm sure a threat will suffice.
But that's its own kind of tragedy too.
I'm so beyond tired of conflict.
And there's nothing to do but build a little bridge...
TITANIA: Taking a rest after the train jacking?
Yeah, I know about it.
Mr. Rock Dundee over there hasn’t stopped talking about it.
I’ve got to say, I wish I’d been able to see those Orbs before they got stolen.
They sound like a pain, but I’m honestly a bit curious.
Of course, now they’re lost and that thief’s probably in the back end of nowhere by now, but what can you do.
Maybe they’ll turn up again and I can have a look.
I don’t have much faith in Reborn’s police department, but I think they’re pretty steamed about this.
Anyway, good job.
You’re good at not dying, I’ll give you that,
And Julia seems happy to see Terra, even if literally no one else with any sense is.
...Actually, you know what, forget the 'sense' part.
But it’s still good to see her like that.
So... thanks.
TITANIA: Oh.
Hi.
Do you need something?
I'm trying to read, so.
...I should really pick up another book.
Honestly, I've read this one twice.
Maybe I'll borrow one from Shelly's library.
Be good to check on her.
Good luck out there.
Try not to die.
TITANIA: You've got stuff to do, right?
Go on.
TITANIA: Look, I don't actually mind talking when there's something to talk about.
But small talk for the sake of small talk?
Just kill me.
AMARIA: Oh,
...I'm really not sure what I should say to you anymore.
After everything--
After an absolutely inexcusable amount of everything--
It would be rude to you to just ignore it,
It was never your fault,
But apologizing for it will only make me worse.
What does anyone who's suffering want, I guess?
To be seen, perhaps?
To know that even if no one can save them, they're not alone and forgotten?
What good is that?
None, and yet, I suppose it's all we can offer.
For everything I've inflicted on you, \PN, I won't apologize,
But I see you,
And I appreciate that you were there.
Welcome back, \PN!
To Reborn, that is; not just this place.
How was Kalos anyway?
Somehow I didn't think you'd be back so soon from the way Julia talked about it.
Don't tell me the secret lover you took with you already left!
I'm always here if you need to talk about anything!
You know what's funny?
Julia originally said that it was Tania that you took with you!
Isn't that funny?
Of course, she was in the next room over when she said that, so I knew she was lying.
But then you really were gone for quite a while, weren't you?
Next, someone's gonna tell me that you and Lin were...
...Perhaps it's better we don't go there!
Anyway, great to see you again!
AMARIA: Oh, \PN. Back so soon?
So nice to see you again!
Julia told me you... "eloped"... after beating Lin.
"To Kalos," she said.
..."With Tania"...
Well, it was a funnier joke after Tania showed up again without you!
She's not exactly the eloping type, of course!
So there's no way it could be true, right?
Anyway, you should come by my gym again someday.
I had a lot of fun last time.
AMARIA: Oh, I’m surprised to see you!
After what happened with the train heist, I wasn’t sure if you’d be around here for a while.
You were security detail when it was robbed, after all!
Oh, but I’m sure you couldn’t have predicted what might happen. I was just worried you might be embarrassed.
I did want to ask you, actually!
What was it like, holding the Blue Orb?
I’ve always wanted to see it. An artifact swirling with the pure, concentrated essence of the deep…
It sounds wonderful.
I do hope the thief gets caught. I’d really love to see it for myself.
In the meantime, don’t let one failed mission discourage you.
I’m sure there’ll be others!~
AMARIA: Oh, \PN! I wondered if we’d see you around here.
I’m so glad you were there to make sure that train heist didn’t go too awry.
Oh, I know it was a bit of a fiasco, but no one was hurt!
I do almost wish I’d been there, though…
I’ve always wanted to see the Blue Orb up close.
An artifact swirling with the pure concentrated essence of the ocean… It sounds beautiful.
Oh, but you got to see it quite close up, didn’t you?
I envy you, honestly.
With any luck, the authorities will catch the thief and bring him to justice.
At any rate, Julia’s sure in a good mood!
I’m sure it will all work out.
Thank you again, \PN!
AMARIA: ...?
Oh, hello!
Sorry if I'm a bit...
Distracted?
I've been trying to enjoy this little break from my Gym duties, but...
AMARIA: Well, \PN, you battled him.
Have you ever seen Shade blink?
Because I haven't.
Not for as long as I've been here.
I'm glad he's come to enjoy himself, but...
It's just a bit unnerving.
That's all...
AMARIA: You know how sometimes when you're in the shower, and you accidentally rub your eyes,
And then you suddenly don't want to do anything other than rub your eyes?
Usually I stop myself, because duh.
One time, I decided just to let myself do it.
Surely it has to feel that way for a reason.
Maybe I just have something stuck in there, in the corner of my eye,
Or maybe it's something to do with the water and the heat.
I figured I'd find out, if there's really any reason to stop.
It didn't take too long.
Eventually it just started burning.
Why would the nerves in our eyes feel good for just long enough to trick us into hurting ourselves?
What is it that tells us to stop before it actually hurts?
If I could find the answer to these questions,
Maybe it would be easier to get out of bed each morning.
AMARIA: ...Hey, \PN. I know I said I wouldn't apologize.
And that's still true.
But, maybe, to make up for everything...
...Try telling someone "battlebond".
I'm sure it'll work out for you.
AMARIA: Dancing is good for the same reason swimming is.
Endorphins, you know?
We have to do everything we can to stay afloat.
AMARIA: How many people are in this place?
How many of them are you choosing, after everything, to talk to me instead of?
Whatever you hope to gain here, you won't.
Just move on.
AMARIA: I've gotta say, I love the lights here.
Maybe I need to tweak mine at home.
AMARIA: I don't have anything to say to you.
You've heard me talk far too much anyway.
Why bother holding your own head under the water when you already can't breathe?
AMARIA: It's nice to be out and among people.
Even if there's no use in trying to talk to them...
Sometimes being there is all that's necessary.
AMARIA: If you ever need back up, you can feel free to call me.
Promise I'll be on my best behavior~
HARDY: So, firstly:
Thanks for helping Aya out with all that Genesect business.
Glad the girl's got more on backups than just me.
Second:
She really burn a whole battalion to a crisp?
Mate, like...
I donno, that's pretty wicked, innit?
I'm thinkin' of writing a new song based off of it.
"Melting My Heart Like An Invader Army"
...Aite, the title needs some workshopping.
But the chords, mate.
It's all about the chords.
HARDY: You don't gotta tell her I said this, but...
Thanks for helpin' out my sis.
'Ppreciate it.
Kinda feel lousy I couldn't get the 'Quaza to do it myself.
Can't even use type matchups as an excuse.
But maybe what's not important is saving people, but being there for them!
Yea!
Yea...
HARDY: How's about that Circus concert, ay mate?
I wasn't there, sure, but I caught a video.
That Meloetta...
She's got some talent, that's for sure!
Not usually my kind of tunes, but when you've got it, you've got it, y'know?
Sorta makes me think, though-- maybe I should see about playin' up there.
Sure drew enough of a crowd.
Not now, with all the Anomalies runnin' around, but maybe later on.
I could get the whole band together!
'Course, that's assuming the crowd didn't just come for Meloetta...
I wouldn't blame 'em if they did.
But it wouldn't hurt to give it a shot!
HARDY: ...
Oh, sorry, \PN, I was thinkin' out loud there.
Take good care of that Meloetta there.
You've got a real star on your hands!
HARDY: Lookin' good, there, \PN.
Glad to see you’re still in one piece.
Adrienn was tellin' us about the train mishap.
Honestly, I don't know what that thief wanted 'em for, anyway.
Those Orbs are a right pain in the arse.
Completely wrecked my jacket, burned a hole in the pocket,
And Aya's lunch got totally ruined when that Blue one decided to act up.
I get that they’re pretty powerful, but is it really worth it?
Ah, well.
Hopefully wherever that guy is, he's havin' as much trouble as we did.
HARDY: This place has a good beat.
Needs more guitars though.
More soul.
HARDY: You think they'd miss if one or two of those amps went missing?
HARDY: Yo, I'mma hire the guy doing the lights here for our next show.
Just wait.
HARDY: The only downside to this place is that it ain't great for practicing.
I wonder how the acoustics are in the back...
SAPHIRA: Hey, \PN. Been a while.
Guess everyone's filled you in?
I heard you got back a while ago.
Don't worry. I'm not pressing you about what happened.
Heard a few things, but it's hard to tell what's true anyway.
Either way, I'm the last person to judge.
I guess you'll be dealing with some of these Legendaries that've been popping out of thin air?
Pretty sure the help will be appreciated.
SAPHIRA: I've focused for too long on the past.
It's time to start thinking about the future.
Not too long ago, this city was filled with broken buildings and ruins.
Those structures became the foundation for countless new homes and businesses.
I wonder what I can become.
SAPHIRA: If you hear about one of those Anomalies running around Labradorra, leave it to me, got it?
I've already had my Gym hijacked once;
I'm not letting anything else fuck it up.
So let me know, hm?
SAPHIRA: Be careful out there.
If you meet any immovable objects, you know which unstoppable force to call.
